GBIF Gap Finder

Overview

This report analyses how well GBIF occurrence data covers the national taxonomy backbone (Dyntaxa). Every species in the backbone is checked against GBIF records through a 4-tier reconciliation: direct name match, synonym resolution, infraspecific collapse, and GBIF Species API lookup.

Troudet Sampling Bias

The Troudet-style analysis compares each taxonomic group’s share of known species against its share of occurrence records. Groups with negative bias are under-represented in GBIF relative to their species richness.
